name: Rite of Passage: Sword of Fury
summary: Search for your missing grandpa in this hidden object game. It seems that he and his adventurous friends opened a portal to a mysterious realm and now you must close it if you want to save him. Board a train and venture into this new world and faceoff against dangerous creatures. Use your magical sword to navigate through spooky hidden objects scenes and gather clues to solve cryptic puzzles.
